question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and express shipping 1-2 business days. Orders placed before 2 pm (local time) on a business day ship the same day. You get a tracking number by email as soon as the order ships.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery; electronics within 15 days. Final-sale items cannot be returned. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Start a return from your order and we email a prepaid return label.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item reaches our warehouse. You get an email confirmation when the refund is processed. Bank processing can add 2-3 days.

question: My item arrived damaged or defective. What should I do?
answer: Sorry about that. Contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number and a photo of the damage. We send a free replacement or a full refund, and you don't pay for return shipping on damaged or defective items.

question: Can I change or cancel my order?
answer: You can change the shipping address or cancel an order while it is still PROCESSING. Once it has SHIPPED it can't be changed: wait for delivery and start a return instead.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Gift cards can be combined with any of these. Your card is charged when the order ships.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Chat with us here 24/7, email support@shopassist.example.com, or call +1 800 555 0142 (Mon-Fri, 9 am-6 pm ET). For an existing case, quote your ticket number (TCK-xxxxxx).

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Use the tracking number in your shipping confirmation email on the carrier's website (UPS, FedEx, DHL or USPS), or ask this assistant for your order status with your order number.
